title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E12 — Biscuits and Scones
Buttermilk biscuits; angel biscuits; cream scones.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S1 E13 — Muffins and Popovers
Blueberry muffins two ways -- flavored with spice or finished with a crumb topping; airy popovers that can be served with blueberry preserves or creamed spinach.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E1 — Coffee Cakes
Rhubarb upside-down crumb cake; jam-filled coffee cake muffins; streusel cake; glazed lemon-blueberry coffee cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E2 — Shortbread
Shortbread wedges; brown-butter shortbread lemon bars; brown sugar pecan shortbread cookies; pumpkin tart.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E4 — Cookies
Brown sugar chocolate chip cookies; old-fashioned lemon sugar cookies; chewy chocolate ginger-molasses cookies; sable; glazed citrus doodles.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E8 — The Science of Woks and Frying
Martha and Chef Kenji Lopez-Alt make extra-crunchy fried chicken sandwiches, tempura shrimp with vegetables, and finally a perfectly stir-fried beef with broccoli.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E4 — Pasta Night
Tonight is pasta night in Bedford; Martha and friends make three pasta dishes, including a recipe from her new restaurant, The Bedford, a no-knife spaghetti, and a lemon angel hair pasta.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E7 — A Classic French Dish: Pot Au Feu
Martha prepares pot-au-feu, a hearty French dish of root vegetables and various cuts of meat, all braised in a savory broth; it's served with sliced meat, vegetables and delicious accompaniments!

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E9 — Vietnamese Cuisine
Martha creates an incredible Vietnamese feast with her friend Monica Tran, including lettuce-wrapped golden fried spring rolls, traditional pho soup, and savory sizzling pancakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E10 — Sweet and Savory Apple Dishes
Martha makes homemade apple cider, a tender pork roast with apples and braised red cabbage; and of course, we can't have an apple show without dessert.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E1 — Perfect Chicken Dinner
Martha serves up a delicious chicken dinner with fresh ingredients from her greenhouse; joined by her good friend Kevin Sharkey, they celebrate the perfect meal for a taste of home-cooked goodness.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E3 — Vegetables
Simple vegetable side dishes include steamed spinach, sautéed broccoli rabe, roasted cauliflower steaks, brown sugar-glazed carrots, sautéed sugar snap peas and shelled peas with mint and lemony kale salad.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E6 — Rice
Fluffy white rice; pilaf; risotto; Thai fried rice.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E7 — Dressings and Emulsions
Shallot vinaigrette prepared two different ways; creamy blue cheese dressing; mayonnaise; BLT.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E8 — Steaming
Cooking chicken breasts in parchment paper; cleaning and steaming mussels; using a bamboo steamer to prepare steamed salmon and peas.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E10 — Braising
Which cuts of meat are good for braising; classic pot roast; braised cabbage with apples; pulled pork sandwiches.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E12 — Frying
French fries; pan-fried chicken; Japanese tempura vegetables with dipping sauces.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E13 — Pan Searing
Pan-seared scallops with lemon-caper sauce; crisp-skinned salmon filet; pan-seared steak with mustard-cream sauce; Muscovy duck breasts with port wine reduction.
